blocks.text: Nigeria is often referred to as the 'Giant of Africa' due to its vast natural resources. But what exactly makes these resources so significant?

blocks.markdown: Nigeria is blessed with a variety of natural resources, which play a crucial role in its economy. These resources include petroleum, natural gas, coal, limestone, tin, and farmland. Among these, petroleum is the most significant, contributing immensely to the nation's revenue.

blocks.title: Natural Resources
blocks.text: Natural resources are materials or substances that occur in nature and can be used for economic gain.

blocks.markdown: Petroleum, also known as crude oil, is the most important natural resource in Nigeria. It accounts for a large percentage of the country's revenue and export earnings. The oil industry is a major source of employment and has a significant impact on the Nigerian economy.

blocks.title: Contribution of Crude Oil to Government Revenue
blocks.prompt: Calculate the percentage contribution of crude oil to Nigeria's government revenue if the total revenue is ₦10 trillion and the revenue from crude oil is ₦6 trillion.

steps.text: Identify the total revenue and the revenue from crude oil.
steps.latex: Total\ Revenue = ₦10\ trillion,\ Crude\ Oil\ Revenue = ₦6\ trillion

steps.text: Use the formula to calculate the percentage contribution.
Substitute the values into the formula.

blocks.answer: The contribution of crude oil to Nigeria's government revenue is 60%.

blocks.markdown: Despite its benefits, relying heavily on oil presents challenges. Economic instability can occur due to fluctuating oil prices, and over-dependence can hinder the development of other sectors.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: When discussing natural resources in exams, always mention both their contributions and the potential drawbacks of reliance on them.
